findings.failure_path: Lane 3 ran before an explicit second grant existed. This record withdraws the controller's original interpretation but then claims a later instruction covers the earlier lane. That is another controller-side reconstruction: authorization issued later cannot establish that the lane was authorized when executed, and the supplied diff contains no explicit maintainer ratification of lane 3's already-produced receipts and fixes. The audit trail can therefore present an unauthorized lane as human-authorized.
findings.smallest_fix: Record lane 3 as unauthorized at execution time and obtain an explicit maintainer ratification that specifically accepts retention and use of its existing receipts and fixes; otherwise exclude that lane from the authorization chain and rerun it under a prospective grant.
